capabilities.summary: Treat external model output as untrusted and reject represented unsupported employers, titles, skills, numbers, and source-bullet mutations before a tailored result is accepted.
capabilities.claim_ceiling: Deterministic represented fabrication modes are tested; semantic completeness and hiring-outcome correctness are not established.

capabilities.summary: Read API request bodies incrementally, enforce encoded byte limits, validate JSON/schema boundaries, and separate expected client failures from internal server failures.
capabilities.claim_ceiling: Repository-level request boundary behavior is implemented and tested; production rate limiting and abuse protection are not established.

capabilities.summary: Materialize a human-reviewed tailored résumé into deterministic ATS text, auditable JSON, and complete printable HTML while preserving explicit non-submission and non-PDF boundaries.
capabilities.claim_ceiling: ATS/JSON/HTML compilation is tested; browser E2E and production deployment are not established.

capabilities.summary: Compile a deterministic target-requirement evidence brief from structured resume and job-description inputs, preserving exact source references while separating supported, partial, and unsupported lexical evidence.
capabilities.claim_ceiling: Lexical source evidence and target coverage are computed deterministically; semantic qualification, recruiter judgment, and hiring outcomes are not inferred.

capabilities.summary: Bind tailored experience proposals back to company, title, and original bullet identity so multiple roles at one employer remain distinct and ambiguous proposals preserve source content.
capabilities.claim_ceiling: The represented experience identity contract is tested; complete semantic equivalence is not claimed.

capabilities.summary: Persist private tailoring runs in browser-local IndexedDB with revision checks, serialized writes, bounded retention, restore/delete/clear operations, and explicit failure reporting.
capabilities.claim_ceiling: Local browser persistence mechanics are implemented; server-side identity, cross-device sync, encryption policy, and production retention governance are not established.
